units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 47:26">Targ. Y. Gen. XLVII, 26</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 53b:11">B. Mets. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ מלגיו</he> the one fifth is included in the amount, i.e. the addition is one fifth of the principal (v. <cite ref="H00397">preced. w.</cite>); <he>ח׳ מלבר</he> the one fifth is excluded, i.e. the addition must form one fifth of the principal plus the addition (25 percent), v. <cite ref="B01153"><he>בַּר</he></cite> I ch.—Ib. 54ᵇ <he>ח׳ דח׳</he> a fine of one fifth for misappropriating the addition of one fifth; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חוּמְשֵׁי</he>.
